item.title: Thunderstorm Advisory No. 4 #VISPRSD
item.description:

Moderate to Heavy rainshowers with lightning and strong winds are expected over #NegrosOccidental(Ilog), #NegrosOriental(CityOfTanjay and CityOfBayawan) within the next 1 to 2 hours.

The above conditions are being experienced in #NegrosOccidental(CityOfKabankalan), #NegrosOriental(Ayungon, Bindoy, Manjuyod, BaisCity and Mabinay) which may persist within 1 to 2 hours and may affect nearby areas.

All are advised to take precautionary measures against the impacts associated with these hazards which include flash floods and landslides. Keep monitoring for updates.
